description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for Git's handling of large files and conversion filters, including setup, input/output filtering, and large file size checks.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.description: Sets attributes for conversion filters and writes to .gitattributes

methods.name: check_input
methods.description: Verifies input conversion filters by comparing git indexed files

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Verifies output conversion filters by checking out files and comparing contents
